title: Cleanup Suggestions
description:
Cleanup Suggestions surfaces concept sets, cohort definitions, and analyses you own that are still active but haven't been used or updated in 90+ days. It helps you keep your workspace tidy by recommending stale items to archive.

Archiving is non-destructive — items move out of your active lists but remain fully recoverable from the Library's Trash tab.
tips: Items appear here only after 90 days of inactivity — recently touched work is never flagged.
Archiving is reversible: restore anything from the Library Trash tab if you need it again.
Use the bulk archive action to clear several stale items in one step.
Tidying your active lists makes search and selection faster across the whole platform.
An empty page ('All clean') means none of your items are currently stale.
Cleanup only ever suggests items you own — it never touches other users' work.
